How it works

Three steps, no technical setup

Once Teach Me appears in the Plugins Directory, you can add it and use it in a normal ChatGPT conversation.

Add the plugin

Open Teach Me | علّمني in the Plugins Directory and select Add.

Start a new chat

Select +, choose More, then select Teach Me | علّمني.

State your goal plainly

Say what you want to learn, what you know now, and why you need it. No special prompt format is required.

What is different?

More than a long answer

Teach Me gives ChatGPT a clear teaching approach while keeping you in control of the pace.

Clear privacy

Teach Me does not need your conversation

The Teach Me server returns public, reviewed teaching guidance to ChatGPT. It does not request your conversation, files, credentials, or personal data, and it stores no learner state.

Common questions

Before you begin

Do I need another account or API key?

No. You use Teach Me inside ChatGPT with your existing account. Teach Me does not require a separate account.

Is Teach Me available to everyone now?

The plugin is currently under OpenAI review. The install link will activate here after approval and publication.

Does it work on mobile?

We will verify the mobile and ordinary-account experience after publication. Plugin availability may vary by ChatGPT account and plan.

Do I need to type /teacher or /kids?

No. Write naturally after selecting Teach Me. Those are optional text aliases, not native ChatGPT slash commands.

Can it teach from a file, book, or video?

Yes when ChatGPT can access the content. Teach Me states which pages, text, images, or transcripts were inspected and never claims inaccessible coverage.

Does it guarantee every answer is correct?

No. Teach Me improves the teaching approach but cannot guarantee perfect accuracy. Current or consequential information needs suitable authoritative sources.
